description: Phase 3 Demo: RegTech Compliance Protocol. Generate a new standard-library module defining KYC/AML compliance checking with enum-based customer classification and forall-quantified transaction limit verification. The generated file MUST define `enum CustomerType { Individual, Corporate, Government, PEP }` and `enum RiskLevel { Low, Medium, High, Critical }` with refinement types `type RiskScore = i64 where v >= 0 && v <= 100;` and `type TransactionAmount = i64 where v >= 0;`. Each classification atom MUST use `match` with exhaustive coverage of all enum variants — Z3 will reject non-exhaustive matches with counter-examples. Quantifier atoms MUST use `forall(i, 0, n, ...)` in `requires:` for universal compliance properties. Guard-based match arms (`a if a <= threshold => ...`) are used for amount-based approval levels. No temporal effects or resource hierarchy — this demo focuses on match exhaustiveness + forall quantifiers only.

atoms.name: classify_risk
atoms.description: Map customer type to risk level using exhaustive match. Individual(0)->Low(0), Corporate(1)->Medium(1), Government(2)->Low(0), PEP(3)->Critical(3). Z3 verifies all 4 customer types are covered.

atoms.name: get_transaction_limit
atoms.description: Determine transaction limit based on risk level using exhaustive match. Low->1000000, Medium->500000, High->100000, Critical->10000. All limits are strictly positive.

atoms.name: check_transaction
atoms.description: Check if a single transaction complies with the customer's risk-based limit. Composes classify_risk and get_transaction_limit, then compares amount against the limit. Returns 1 (compliant) or 0 (non-compliant).

atoms.name: verify_all_transactions_compliant
atoms.description: Universal quantifier: all transactions in the array are within the specified limit. Uses forall(i, 0, n, arr[i] >= 0 && arr[i] <= limit) in requires.
atoms.requires: n >= 0 && limit > 0 && forall(i, 0, n, arr[i] >= 0 && arr[i] <= limit)

atoms.name: verify_all_risk_scores_within_threshold
atoms.description: Universal quantifier: all customer risk scores are within the threshold. Uses forall with RiskScore refinement type (0-100).
atoms.requires: n >= 0 && threshold >= 0 && threshold <= 100 && forall(i, 0, n, arr[i] >= 0 && arr[i] <= threshold)

atoms.name: full_kyc_check
atoms.description: Composite KYC check combining customer classification (match exhaustiveness) with transaction history verification (forall quantifier). The most complex atom exercising both Phase 3 features simultaneously.
atoms.requires: customer_type >= 0 && customer_type <= 3 && amount >= 0 && n_history >= 0 && limit > 0 && forall(i, 0, n_history, arr[i] >= 0 && arr[i] <= limit)

atoms.name: approval_level
atoms.description: Determine approval level based on transaction amount using match with guard conditions. <=10000->Auto(0), <=100000->Manager(1), <=1000000->Director(2), >1000000->Board(3).
